selection: Every finite contract-valid candidate in the frozen one-proposal feedback-generation handoff; no selection on the new reference outcome.
budget_rationale: One independently bounded reference attempt after a real feedback-selected model proposal. Historical 9- and 13-atom chains used about 1048-1463 GPU seconds; this 16-atom development input may fail or time out. One 3305-second recovery envelope fits one GPU-hour and eight CPU-core-hours, with 3000 primitives and 0.5 GiB. No automatic retry, cap extension or training allocation is created.
claim_limits: A functional development pipeline using historical trained weights, with unresolved training overlap; not independent confirmation or a method comparison.
Gas phase is explicitly declared for this new modeling task; the source geometry environment remains unknown.
Unresolved, alternative and matched channels retain distinct evidence states; a pipeline completion does not imply a certified TS.
Generation and reference ledgers are separate and both contribute to end-to-end cost. Scheduler/setup overhead must also be included in later cost comparisons.
Only gas-phase neutral singlet CHNO and this versioned reference protocol are supported; raw coordinates and weights remain private on n2.
